title: Glycolysis Pathway Simulator
description: Interactive visualization of the ten glycolysis reactions with investment/payoff highlighting, ATP/NADH badges, and clickable reaction cards.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Biology
Biochemistry
Cellular Respiration

learningObjectives: Describe substrates, enzymes, and products for each glycolysis step.
Differentiate the energy investment and payoff phases by tracking ATP/NADH changes.
Explain why glycolysis nets +2 ATP and +2 NADH per glucose.
prerequisites: Knows the overall goal of cellular respiration
Can define NADH and substrate-level phosphorylation
assessmentOpportunities: Exit ticket listing ATP-consuming and ATP-producing steps
Discussion on why the payoff steps are doubled

keyQuestions: Where in glycolysis is ATP consumed?
Which step produces NADH and why is it doubled?
commonMisconceptions: Only one pyruvate forms per glucose
